text:
alex_d: Heads up — after the node kernel bump + CUDA 12.2 driver refresh in euc1 this morning, we've seen sustained NCCL allreduce throughput drop ~40% on clusters with EFA attached. ICMP/ethtool show higher retransmits. Anyone seen this pattern before?

sara_ops: saw similar alerts in staging earlier. I opened a quick perf trace, looks like frequent tx stalls on mlx5 links when brokers use huge MTU packets.

lee_infra: Can you paste the ethtool / counters output? Also which OFED version did we push?

alex_d: OFED 5.7.0 + FW 15.28 pushed at 08:12 by the rollout bot. Log snippet below: 

```
05:20:11 tx_errors: 0  tx_dropped: 3  rx_errors: 15  rx_crc_errors: 5  rx_missed_errors: 2
mlx5_0: TX queue restart count: 120
NCCL INFO: comm 0x7f8e3 badge drop, retry
```

devon_ml: On the affected jobs I'm seeing repeated NCCL warn: "transport error: retrying" and then fallback to TCP. That explains latency spikes.

nina_sre: @deploy-bot did we roll any kernel patches around that time too?

deploy-bot: verde-deploy: kernel-6.1.12 and cuda-driver-525.85.05 rolled to euc1 nodes at 08:06; ofed-5.7.0 and mlx-fw-15.28 rolled at 08:12. No rollback yet.

lee_infra: Interesting — devs on the vendor list mentioned a mlx5 driver ABI change in kernel 6.1.12 that can alter coalescing behavior with certain FW. Might be triggering more coalesce+retry combos leading to retransmits.

alex_d: Quick repro plan: isolate a small pool, revert FW on one node to 15.20, keep kernel+driver the same, run nccl/allreduce perf and compare. Any objections?

sara_ops: +1, prefer isolate in prod-sandbox pool so we don't hit customer jobs. I'll reserve two nodes.

devon_ml: Also please capture tcpdump and ibdump capture — need to see if packets are being dropped at NIC or higher. nccl-tests with --gpus=8 --iter=200 is a good workload.

lee_infra: I'll prepare a kernel module log level increase and collect mlx logs (`dmesg | grep mlx5 -A5`) and ethtool -S before/after.

nina_sre: If we confirm FW is the culprit, revert plan for cluster is to roll back FW on the remaining updated nodes and pause further ofed-fw batches. Keep kernel+cuda on hold until we validate. Notify customers via status if ETA for rollback >30m.

alex_d: Running the repro now on sandbox nodes s-euc1-075/076. Starting nccl tests.

(6m later)

alex_d: Repro result: node with FW 15.28 shows 38% lower allreduce throughput and visible tx stalls; node with 15.20 stable. tcpdump shows retransmits before NIC tx queue restart.

lee_infra: Confirmed. dmesg from failing node: `mlx5_core 0000:06:00.0: mlx5_core: TX queue timeout, restarting` and then `mlx5_core: firmware reload` messages.

sara_ops: filing incident ticket with vendor, attaching captures. For short-term, I'll schedule rollback of fw to 15.20 on the rest of euc1 updated nodes. Estimated 12 nodes per hour.

devon_ml: for future, we should add an automated perf smoke after infra rolls that runs nccl microbench for 5m on a canary node and alerts on >15% regression vs baseline.

nina_sre: Agreed — add canary + immediate rollback trigger. I'll draft runbook changes.

alex_d: Thanks. I'll paste the capture links and the quick diff of perf numbers here shortly.

sara_ops: capture + notes uploaded: https://internal-redwood/uploads/efa-1850012345/capture.tar.gz 

lee_infra: vendor response ETA 2h, they asked for the full mlx logs and the nccl tests. Ticket ID VEND-3321.

nina_sre: We'll notify support channels to watch for customer impact and block further ofed/fw rollouts until VEND-3321 resolved. :rotating_light:

alex_d: Closing loop — rolling back remaining nodes now. Will follow-up with RCA once vendor confirms root cause.

(Last message)

alex_d: Post-rollback quick check: aggregate allreduce throughput back to baseline within 10% margin. Marking incident mitigated for now.
